page.notes: Greek words in the body and in the margin note are read with doubt and marked [?]: the margin Greek after "Sententiæ", and the four Greek words in the last paragraph. "es" in IX is doubtful. "huncergo" is printed as one word. The catchword "danda" stands at the right below the last line.
